correctness.rationale: The finite-poset cap lemma handles all selfmaps of Q⊕D_m: maps hitting an apex from the base or with nonautomorphism restriction, or constant apex transformation, are nullhomotopic; remaining automorphisms of Q combined with nonconstant apex transformations are isolated, with composition sending constant composites to zero. Both Q=P(9) and Q=D2 have no greatest element, two automorphisms C2, and all nonautomorphism selfmaps null. An independent Python enumeration reconstructed 13 Hasse covers, listed all 12,575 isotone P9 selfmaps with homotopy components 12,573/1/1, and all 232,727 P9⊕D2 maps with components 232,723/1/1/1/1. The universal count follows from exactly m^m-m nonconstant transformations and two base automorphisms. Category triple for X_m follows from Mosquera-Lois/Tanaka source theorem; D2⊕Dm has order complex K_{2,m}, giving H1 rank m-1 and the cited category triple.
